title: No rp or anything
content: I tried to write it with as much detail as I could remember I’ve wrote another of my dreams here and to see other people having similar dreams to mine is terrifying and concerning I am not role playing or inventing these dreams of mine. In this dream I started on the second-highest floor of a massive parking garage. It was bright and sunny outside. I ran to the edges of the building to look around, and from there I could see a huge structure (what I think was the mall) and beyond that, an infinite stretch of ocean. It felt like the whole area I was in was part of an incredibly massive island. There were no roads leading toward the big building The parking garage itself looked like it had 50+ floors, so it was huge. Walking around, I noticed it was packed full of vehicles (cars, SUVs, motorcycles, and trucks). I kept wandering, looking around, and eventually found the ramp that led to the top floor As I went up, I realized there was nobody else around. It was completely silent, which felt strange for a parking garage. When I finally reached the top floor, there were only three vehicles: a black SUV and two motorcycles (one blue and the other dark red). Lined up perfectly with the ramp was an elevator door. Stepping in front of this chrome-like metallic elevator, I quickly realized it didn’t have any buttons or sensors to activate it. Then, almost like it was reading my mind, the doors slid open, The inside of the elevator was completely empty (no buttons, no control panel, nothing). The walls were made of glass, and I could see through them into a huge expanse of grassy plains stretching out in every direction. It felt endless, After what seemed like ten minutes, the elevator finally stopped at the ground floor. I stepped out and looked around, and the first thing I noticed was a staircase nearby. The staircase led me to a glass door. Passing through it felt like stepping into some kind of art museum mixed with a mall. There were paintings and sculptures everywhere, but also stores scattered around. Some of the stores I could recognize, others I couldn’t tell what they were for at all, The hallways were wide and tall, all white, with high windows along the walls. The floor was a dark gray (almost black) and if you looked closely, it had tiny specks that shimmered like stars in space, The paintings were strange. Every time I tried to focus on one, it would suddenly turn pitch black (almost like a void). The sculptures were even stranger; they changed every time I looked away (one moment a huge bronze bull, the next a Roman statue, then something modern and abstract)the feeling I got from this place was calm, peaceful (like somewhere I didn’t want to leave). It felt comforting in a way that’s hard to explain walking around this place was interesting. There were very few people (some seemed familiar, like I’d seen them before). Others would try to talk to me, but no sound came out (like they were on mute). Then there were others who just stood still and stared so feeling a lil bit weird about that I kept walking until I came across a glass bridge connecting to another area that looked similar but somehow different. I made it about halfway across when the bridge suddenly collapsed (and I woke up with a jolt, with that falling sensation you get right before you drift off to sleep). Again I am not Role Playing or anything of the sort I simply want to share my what I think is mall world dreams.
